Students crossing intersections
Cyclists weaving through streets
Café patrons sitting outdoors

VISUAL STYLE

Contemporary editorial illustration
Precision architectural drawing
Minimalist monoline artwork
Swiss International Style poster design
Japanese graphic design influence
Museum-quality city branding aesthetic
Clean vector rendering
Geometric perspective construction
Strong use of negative space
Sophisticated visual hierarchy

LINEWORK

Extremely fine monoline strokes
Technical illustration precision
No sketchiness
Dense urban detailing
Organized rhythm of windows, cables, signs, bicycles, storefronts, railings, and street furniture
Intricate composition that remains visually calm and readable

COLOR CONCEPT

Use a restrained two-color silkscreen system:

One carefully selected ink color
One contrasting paper/background color

Choose colors that evoke Tokyo’s refined urban energy and contemporary design culture.

Suggested palette:

Deep vermilion ink on warm rice-paper ivory stock

Avoid gradients, neon effects, multiple accent colors, or photographic lighting.

TYPOGRAPHY

Top:
TOKYO

Bottom:
東京

Typography should feel like a luxury design publication or cultural exhibition poster.

Perfect kerning
Clean editorial layout
Modern sans-serif typography
Authentic Japanese signage throughout the illustration
No distorted or unreadable text

MOOD

Not a tourist destination.

Not a postcard.

A visual celebration of Tokyo’s everyday elegance, urban rhythm, design culture, and human-scale density.

The poster should feel like it belongs in a contemporary art museum, premium travel journal, or international design exhibition.

OUTPUT

Vertical composition (4:5 or 2:3 ratio)
Ultra-high-resolution 8K
Print-ready poster design
Crisp vector-qu\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dreamy vertical café advertisement illustration/photo-real anime hybrid for a seasonal shaved ice dessert, with a soft golden summer light and romantic flower-garden atmosphere.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, warm ivory and honey color palette, shallow depth of field, intricate details, glowing backlight through a rustic window, vintage cottage café interior filled with daisies, lace, dried flowers, and weathered wood.

Main subject: On the right side, show one beautiful young woman with long wavy blonde hair, fair skin, large soft brown eyes, delicate makeup, and a calm wistful expression. She rests her cheek on one hand and holds a gold spoon in the other. She wears a cream lace crochet dress with scalloped cuffs and a floral crown made of small white and pale pink flowers. Her pose is gentle, elegant, and slightly melancholic, looking toward the viewer.

Dessert centerpiece: In the lower center foreground, place exactly one oversized bowl of shaved ice in a clear glass coupe dish on a glass saucer. The shaved ice is pale milk-honey colored with syrup crystals, topped with exactly one round scoop of ice cream, decorated with white daisies, tiny yellow fruit cubes, pale peach mochi-like spheres, mint leaves, and sparkling sugar. Make it look like a fantasy flower-crown honey milk shaved ice.

Visible repeated elements to include: exactly 2 framed signs on the left, exactly 1 small paper tag at the bottom left, exactly 1 gold wax seal near the tag, exactly 1 white rabbit figurine or plush on the lower right, exactly 1 gold spoon in the woman’s hand, exactly 1 glass dessert bowl, and abundant small daisies scattered across the table and frames.

Left upper sign: A large antique cream wooden frame covered with daisies and lace ribbons. Text should read: “CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée” with smaller Japanese text “カフェ・フレーズ・エトワレ”, then the slogan “Blooming with my own light.” Use elegant serif typography.

Left lower menu sign: A smaller antique menu card framed in cream wood with botanical decorations. Include Japanese menu text prominently: “季節限定”, “花冠はちみつのミルクかき氷”, “〜やさしい光に包まれて〜”, followed by smaller ingredient lines, and the price “¥2,200(税込)”. Add a tiny hand-drawn heart in the lower right corner.

Bottom tag: A small beige paper card reading “Blooming with my own light.” with a tiny heart sketch.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed, soft focus, romantic shoujo aesthetic, cottagecore, Parisian-Japanese café menu styling, creamy highlights, sun-drenched atmosphere, translucent lace, realistic dessert texture, delicate botanical ornamentation, high-resolution editorial composition.

Constraints: Keep all text legible where possible, no modern objects, no extra people, no extra animals beyond the single rabbit, no watermark, no harsh contrast. The overall mood should feel like Café Fraise Étoilée serving a magical seasonal dessert called flower-crown honey milk shaved ice.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a high-fashion editorial collage showing exactly 5 vertical portrait panels of the same stylish adult male model, with his face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur for anonymity in each panel.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, approximately 1200x675, dark charcoal background with a subtle vignette. Place five tall rectangular photo strips side by side across the center, separated by thin dark dividers, each with cinematic contrast, saturated colors, and a glossy magazine look.

Layout: Use exactly 5 panels, left to right:
1. A man in a deep burgundy suit with a black shirt and black tie, standing against a rich red wall, one hand adjusting the jacket, visible wristwatch.
2. A seated man in a dark emerald green leather biker jacket over a black sweater, black pants, rings on hand, moody teal urban background.
3. A man in a royal blue double-breasted overcoat over a black turtleneck, standing near a pale stone wall in a cool city street, hands clasped near the coat front.
4. A close cropped man in a mustard yellow blazer over a black shirt, standing against a textured yellow wall, adjusting his cuff, visible wristwatch.
5. A full-body man in a shiny purple satin shirt with black trousers, walking through a magenta-lit arched corridor, dramatic purple shadows.

Subject details: The model should appear as a fashionable adult man with dark styled hair, slim-to-athletic build, confident posture, luxury menswear styling, watches and rings as accessories. In every panel, cover the facial features with a centered soft-edged rectangular blur in beige/brown tones, matching the original anonymized look.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion photography, editorial lighting, bold color blocking, sharp clothing texture, high saturation, dramatic shadows, cinematic urban locations, luxury magazine campaign aesthetic.

Customizable details: Use a stylish adult man with dark styled hair and a slim athletic build, 5, bold luxury menswear color-block editorial, soft rectangular blur covering the face in every panel, and dark charcoal gallery backdrop with cinematic vignette.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 vertical panels, keep the panels aligned in a single row, do not add text, logos, watermarks, captions, extra people, or additional panels.\

Her hair decoration contains a clustered arrangement of pastel flowers, including pink roses, blue hydrangea-like blossoms, small lavender flowers, green leaves, pearl beads, and dangling teardrop ornaments, all rendered with embossed clear resin shine. The portrait background is a smooth blue gradient with small bubble motifs; add vertical text inside the artwork reading NOZOMU along the right side, plus small decorative letters near the upper right that resemble bubbles. Use a white ornate frame with beveled molding, silver inner trim, and a subtle beaded edge; the framed board casts realistic shadows and reflections. The label should read: NOZOMU, then “Whisper of Blue Petals”, then “2.5D REAL PRINTING”, “LIMITED TEXTURE ART BOARD”, “UV CLEAR INK LAYER”, and “SPECIAL EXHIBITION SAMPLE”. prompt_en:
Use the uploaded image as the reference image. Preserve its structure, framing, and main visual information.

Recreate the provided image as a realistic handmade artwork by a clever 10-year-old child.

Keep the original image’s main layout, composition, and recognizable content, but transform the entire scene into a 10-year-old child’s watercolor marker drawing mixed with crayon strokes and paper collage craft.

The image should be placed on a clean white paper background. Make it look genuinely handmade, with wobbly outlines, simple shapes, uneven coloring, visible watercolor marker texture, waxy crayon strokes, cut-paper edges, slight glue marks, layered paper pieces, imperfect proportions, and charming childlike details.

Do not use the original color palette. Replace it with bright rainbow colors, soft pastel tones, playful candy colors, and cheerful handmade craft colors.

Add whimsical childlike decorations naturally around the scene: castles, fairy-tale towers, candy, lollipops, stars, smiling clouds, rainbows, hearts, flowers, sparkles, planets, stickers, and random doodles.

Also add fantasy and sci-fi paper-collage characters as if the child added them for fun: a brave armored hero, a silly evil villain, a colorful mecha robot, a cute monster, a floating UFO, friendly little aliens, a lovely princess, and a fun spaceship flying through the sky.

All visible text should be redrawn as childlike handwriting, as if written by a 10-year-old using crayons and watercolor markers. The handwriting should be uneven, slightly messy, cute, naive, with inconsistent letter sizes, irregular spacing, playful wobble, and imperfect alignment.

The final image should feel realistic, smart, imaginative, innocent, colorful, and full of childlike creativity — like a charming school art project made with watercolor markers, crayons, scissors, glue, and colorful paper.\

title: 精灵女孩行走山羊和机器人
author: Eris Create Lab
prompt_en: Create a cinematic anime-realistic background scene on a quiet Japanese suburban residential street in Chofu City, near Jindaiji-dori on a bright summer afternoon. A small elf girl with pale blue bob-cut hair, pointed ears, and a calm profile expression walks from right to left across the foreground, wearing a loose white short-sleeved knee-length dress, white socks, and brown lace-up ankle boots. She holds a rope leash attached to a white goat walking beside her; the goat has short curved horns, shaggy fur, and follows obediently in side view. Behind the goat trails a compact dark steampunk robot companion, squat and armored, made of blackened metal plates, exposed gears, pipes, bolts, red lens eyes, and little horn-like antennae, walking like a loyal mechanical pet. The street slopes gently downhill into the distance, lined with concrete block walls, hedges, small two-story houses with tiled roofs, utility poles, overhead power lines, a curved streetlamp, guardrails, drainage grates, and leafy trees casting dappled shadows on the asphalt. The background should feel like a plausible real Japanese neighborhood, with detailed perspective, distant houses and greenery, blue sky, scattered white clouds, warm sunlight, soft atmospheric haze, and highly detailed painterly rendering. title: 时钟奔跑者蒸汽朋克故事板表
author: Kiki
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,草图 / 线稿,角色,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a professional film storyboard sheet for CLOCKRUNNER, a monochrome pencil-and-ink cinematic storyboard set in a steampunk fantasy world of floating clockwork cities above clouds.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard sheet, approximately 16:9, off-white paper texture, thin black panel borders, hand-drawn production-board aesthetic. Add a top header with PROJECT: CLOCKRUNNER on the left, SCENE: 01 near the top center, and DURATION: ~15 SEC (24 FPS) on the right.

Layout: Use exactly 15 numbered storyboard panels arranged in a clean grid: three rows of five panels. Each panel has a small boxed number in the upper-left corner and a caption block underneath with shot type plus action description. Beneath the 15 panels, add a bottom production strip containing: one character portrait box on the left, a character design notes text box beside it, a visual style notes text box, several full-body/action pose sketches of the heroine across the bottom center, and two detailed chronometer/clock device sketches on the bottom right.

Storyboard panels, exactly 15:
1. Wide establishing shot: a colossal floating city of gears and clock towers drifts above an endless sea of clouds; a narrow metal rail stretches between two suspended platforms.
2. Tracking shot: a young time-smuggler sprints along the rail, mechanical debris raining from above as warning sirens echo.
3. Medium shot: she leaps over broken sections of track; a giant clock mechanism collapses behind her.
4. Close-up: determined eyes and a glowing pocket chronometer spinning in her hand; no panic, only focus.
5. Wide shot: ahead, the rail ends abruptly; a massive gap separates her from the next platform.
6. Medium wide: she accelerates toward the edge; steam erupts from vents beneath the track.
7. Action shot: she launches into the air, coat billowing behind her as she reaches forward.
8. Wide shot: she falls through open sky, far below, clouds swirl around ancient machinery.
9. Close action: a retractable energy tether fires from her wrist; the cable streams toward a rotating clock tower.
10. Medium shot: the tether locks onto a moving gear; the sudden pull swings her across the void.
11. Close shot: she races along the tether; blue sparks trail behind her boots.
12. Wide tracking shot: the camera follows as she glides between giant rotating clock faces, narrowly missing gears spinning all around her.
13. Medium close: she lands briefly on a spinning gear; without stopping, she launches again.
14. Dynamic angle: she bursts through a ring-shaped time portal; fragments of glowing clockwork spiral around her.
15. Wide final shot: she emerges above a luminous city hidden inside the clouds; the horizon glows with golden light as she races toward her destination.

Character: The heroine is The Clockrunner, a female mid-20s athletic agile time-smuggler with short silver hair and asymmetrical bangs, long weathered coat with mechanical details, utility belt filled with time-tech gadgets, glowing pocket chronometer as signature item, steampunk sci-fi aesthetic, fast, fearless, highly resourceful.

Bottom strip details: Include exactly 1 character portrait box, exactly 2 text note boxes, exactly 5 small full-body/action pose studies of the heroine, and exactly 2 chronometer/clock device drawings. The character portrait may have a soft blurred or shaded face area but must still show hair, coat collar, shoulder armor, straps, and clockwork accessories.

Visual style: Cinematic storyboard illustration, ultra-detailed ink sketch, dynamic action composition, steampunk fantasy world, floating cities and giant clockwork structures, high motion energy, monochrome pencil rendering, concept-art quality, 16:9 storyboard panels, film-production storyboard layout, consistent character design across all shots. Use dense hatching, graphite shading, weathered paper, tiny technical details, dramatic perspective, clouds, gears, rails, towers, chains, smoke, and sparks.

Constraints: Keep everything black, gray, and sepia-toned like a scanned pencil production sheet. Make the text legible and in English. Do not add extra panels beyond the 15 listed. No color painting, no photorealism, no modern city elements, no watermark.\
